english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the rear or farthest-back part of a place or object.
Use this all-purpose expression for the area behind a moving person or object.

examples.english: There's a small storeroom at the back of the shop.

examples.english: A truck drove past, sending up a cloud of dust in its wake.
